About

The person and the practice

About Peter

I'm a Client Success Manager, Executive Assistant, and Project Manager based in Cebu City, Philippines, with a decade-long path through BPO. From frontline support, through SME and Team Lead roles, to Assistant Operations Manager and now Client Success Manager.

Today, I support three principals directly: an Australian mortgage broker, two BPO operations leaders, and the COO of a remote staffing company. Handled 30 client accounts across healthcare, finance, automotive, and sales. I'm comfortable operating as an extension of leadership, managing communications, relationships, and day-to-day operations with minimal oversight.

About Prime Kreatives

Prime Kreatives is where that operations discipline meets a creative eye.

The name I build under when the work goes beyond a job description — client-facing reports, one-pagers, brand-consistent decks, and the small systems that make a growing team look sharp.
